project.description: Build the PIC-SURE Visualization image (hms-dbmi/pic-sure-visualization) from the PIC-SURE Maven Build reactor workspace. Build/tag only; deploy happens exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE. Converted from the repo jenkinsfile (deleted) to freestyle.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build"
if [ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh" ]; then . /usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh fi
if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] || ! ls "$MAVEN_WS"/services/pic-sure-visualization-service/target/pic-sure-visualization-service-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" if [ "${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-}" != "$pipeline_build_id" ]; then echo "ERROR: reactor artifacts belong to pipeline '${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-unknown}', expected '$pipeline_build_id'" exit 2 fi
PROXY_ARGS="" if [ -n "${http_proxy:-}" ]; then PROXY_ARGS="--build-arg http_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg https_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=$http_proxy" fi if [ -n "${no_proxy:-}" ]; then PROXY_ARGS="$PROXY_ARGS --build-arg no_proxy=$no_proxy --build-arg NO_PROXY=$no_proxy" fi
docker build $PROXY_ARGS -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-visualization:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-visualization-service" docker tag "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-visualization:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" hms-dbmi/pic-sure-visualization:LATEST
